title: AgentRun demo (demo.json)
$comment: A demo's demo.json: the DemoSpec (demo-spec.schema.json, generated from its type in @parcha/agentrun-pi/signin) and the demo template's own fields. Every field is listed, so a misspelt one is refused. scripts/demo-schema.test.mjs validates every examples/*/demo.json against it.

claim.description: One line: what the agent does and the hard thing it survives.

summary.description: The gallery: the card's one line, what the agent does (never the kill and the resume), at most 140 characters.

category.description: The gallery: one of the six categories.

tags.description: The gallery: 1 to 8 tags, lowercase with hyphens.

extensions.description: The gallery: the open packages the demo shows, each a package of this repository's workspace (scripts/gallery/index.mjs checks).

author.description: The gallery: the author's GitHub handle.

recording.description: The gallery: the recording's directory, relative to the example's folder (default recording).

poster.description: The gallery: the card's still frame, a PNG, JPEG or WebP blob of the recording.

run.description: The gallery: the command that runs the demo live, scoped (npx @parcha/..., node examples/<name>/..., or npm run ...); <version> stands for the release.

targets.description: Where the demo runs: hosted only when every tool has a hosted source.

kill.description: The template's single kill, at the first crossing of point; `kills` is the list, for n, target, where and the rest (examples/reference/demo-spec.ts keeps only point and why here).

kills.description: What --kill does: each entry in order, one per process (examples/reference/demo-spec.ts).

panels.description: The viewer's own panel ids the recording draws.

tools.description: The job's tools that are code of its own: where each runs locally, and the hosted executor tool it is granted (null when none).

input.description: The job's input for --input: what it looks like, its default, and named variants.

fixtures.description: The captures --input may name: each a name, and its fixture under the demo's fixtures/.

sources.description: The checked files the job reads (examples/reference/demo-spec.ts): true for the sources.json beside the demo, or a path to one, from the repository when it starts with examples/ and else from the demo's directory.

browser.description: false: the demo opens no page, so the entry creates no browser, live or on fakes. Default: a browser.

codeMode.description: Code mode: a code tool whose sandbox has tools.bash and vision.see. Off by default.

sites.description: The sites the agent can hand a task to (use_website): each runs a child agent in a browser of its own, starting at startUrl.

boxes.description: The box the job's tools run in (examples/reference/demo-spec.ts).

crossingKill.description: A kill at the nth time the child takes a named crossing.

hold.description: At a crossing that parks (vision.filing): the kill waits until this many filings are parked, or waitMs has passed.

waitMs.description: How long a parking crossing waits for hold filings (default 3000).

where.description: Only a crossing whose info has these values counts (announced through cross(point, { info })); with n, the nth matching crossing. A storm has none.

stormKill.description: kills kills, each at the first crossing taken once gapMs has run.
